_meta.disclaimer: SIMULATED DATA. This file models the concepts of a Pendo-like in-app guide product (guides, segments, install snippet, visitor metadata) for a take-home prototype. It is not connected to Pendo and no Pendo account was used to produce it. All timestamps are relative to the fixed reference time below so demo and eval behavior is reproducible.

apps.name: Acme Web App
apps.sdk_config_change_note: Visitor metadata payload was reconfigured. Fields currently sent per visitor: email, role, company. The plan_tier field was previously sent but was dropped in this change and is no longer included.

apps.name: Acme Mobile App
apps.sdk_config_change_note: No install events received in the last 40 days. The Pendo mobile snippet does not appear to be initialized in the shipped app build.

segments.name: All Visitors
segments.rule_description: Everyone who has been active in the app in the last 90 days. No conditions.

segments.name: Beta cohort
segments.rule_change_note: Rule was updated 2 hours ago to also require plan_tier == 'pro' (previously matched on beta_opt_in alone). Segment membership is recomputed on a rolling ~24-hour cycle, so the estimate below predates this rule change and may not reflect it yet.

segments.name: Power users (legacy)
segments.error_message: The segment evaluation service did not respond within the timeout window. Membership and visitor count could not be retrieved.
